scope: Independent review of root-authored Statistics SessionBridge integration and oracle-authored immutable DTO only. Reviewer-authored saved_statistics core excluded from independent implementation credit; reader covered separately by storage.json.
existing_method_preservation: Removing only new statistics() and its include/metatype registration yields byte-exact baseline cpp; removing DTO include/API/signal yields byte-exact baseline hpp.

checks.subject: Admission/host identity
checks.detail: statistics(session,request) rejects zero or unpublished/foreign session before dispatch. Existing busy gate rejects direct reentry. Worker captures both IDs by value and verifies immutable Host columnLayoutSession before reading; sharing the existing per-Host session identity does not borrow library revision or page address.

checks.subject: Worker ownership/read-only boundary
checks.detail: Only fixed reader readSavedStatisticsView(host_->lease,stop) runs on the existing worker and held lease. No acquire, query, cache/baseline assignment, revision mutation, writer, network or new thread in the added method. The method uses dispatch(...,false), so optional statistics read cancellation/failure never recovers a library snapshot or increments torrent revision.

checks.subject: States/provenance/immutable packet
checks.detail: Packet defaults Failed. Read errors produce a bounded failure string; explicit Cancelled propagates. Missing creates only Missing. Ready requires a recognized Primary/Backup/Saving source and loaded optional snapshot, moved into shared_ptr<const SavedStatistics>; its fresh core source remains owned. All storage source cases are explicitly mapped, with no invented Primary fallback. IDs/state/source/snapshot/failure are plain owned Qt-side fields and const shared packet is metatype-registered.

checks.subject: Queued cancellation/staleness
checks.detail: Stop checks precede and follow reader and precede enqueue. GUI receiver-bound invokeMethod captures stop and immutable packet, rechecks stop plus published session before emitting any statistics result. Cancelled/stale queued packet releases busy without result; optional cancellation message is only after a live QPointer check. Page/request generation admission remains the Window/page responsibility; Bridge does not retain raw page pointers.

checks.subject: Direct signal deletion/reentry safety
checks.detail: busy_ remains true while emitting statisticsReady, preventing direct result slots from replacing current_ or dispatching a command midcompletion. QPointer is constructed before any emission; a result slot deleting Bridge returns immediately. Normal callback stops monitor and sets busy false only after result, then emits its final signal with no subsequent member access. Cancel/stale branch checks QPointer after busyChanged before optional message. QObject-bound queued invocation is removed on receiver destruction.

checks.subject: Executor/destruction boundary
checks.detail: Added worker capture uses existing Bridge lifetime: destructor cancels current and requests shutdown; last-declared Executor is destroyed/joined before Host/lease/tickets/mutex and QObject base. No new callback backpointer, cross-thread GUI field mutation or independent owner process is introduced. Public methods retain the existing GUI-owner-thread calling precondition.

checks.subject: No regression delta outside new API
checks.detail: Exact baseline reconstruction confirms old open/query/refresh/details/progress/saved services/column read/save/dispatch/cancel and their signal order unchanged. Statistics registration adds no file/manager action at construction. Existing session publication while busy permits the Window to queue later optional reads without direct reentry.

downstream_requirements: Window/page must validate nonnull packet, exact live session/request and state/source/snapshot/failure consistency; Bridge output is well formed but public synthetic DTOs remain untrusted.
Result arrives before busy=false; absent/cancelled/failed-dispatch completion must release only matching active Statistics generation and preserve newer pending work.
No current/session/global protocol/history semantics follow from saved values; view must preserve unknown/type/negative provenance and source units.
limitations: Source-only review, no compilation, moc generation, test execution, GUI event loop, queued-cancellation or deletion runtime proof by this reviewer.
Underlying allocation/error text and QObject scheduling behavior retain existing contracts. No allocator-exhaustion no-throw or arbitrary non-GUI-thread public calling guarantee.
This report does not independently review own core implementation, entire Executor, current Window or complete original Java/client statistics.
